Parallel Life · private what-if

Build my world

Map your life as it is now, then branch it: stay, change industry, start a business, move. Each branch runs forward many times from your own numbers and shows a range, not a promise. Every piece is labelled so you always know what is your fact, what is evidence, what is an assumption and what is simulated.

Steps 3 and 4 · What-if and compare

Simulated ranges, side by side

Each band shows where savings ended up in most runs (the shaded range) and the middle run (the line). The red dashed line is zero. Click a branch name to hide or show it.

Keep your world

Nothing is sent anywhere. Keep your world in this browser, or download it as a file you can open again later.

Parallel Life shows simulated ranges from your own numbers and assumptions. It is a tool for thinking a choice through, not a prediction of your future.

Roles are general (an employer, a customer group, a household member). Parallel Life never builds a copy of a real, named person.

If you have done a BaZi reading, its ten-year cycles are shown beside the years as a labelled tradition note. They never change a single figure.

Parallel Life does not simulate health, the end of life or calamities, and it gives no financial, legal, medical or marriage verdicts. For those decisions, speak to a qualified professional.

Everything is worked out on your own device. Nothing is sent to Fate Tutor or anyone else; saving is your choice.

Coming later, with an account: saved worlds across devices, dated public evidence you can attach, and a guided conversation about your branches.
